import Lean
def Payload : Type := Nat
section
variable (arg : Payload)
theorem used : arg = arg := rfl
theorem unused : True := trivial
variable {arg}
include arg
axiom ax : True
theorem included : True := trivial
omit arg
theorem omitted : True := trivial
end

why: A used or explicitly included section variable can introduce constants from its binder type into a theorem signature. Omit removes the forced inclusion. Axioms only abstract used variables.
